description: Interactive settings configuration options for the picker. Each option's `help` text is shown in the context-sensitive help modal (opened with ?/h/F1 on the selected settings row). Keep help lines short — the modal is rendered inside the picker window and long lines are truncated. Rows are rendered in option order; the Zig app resolves help by row index into this same options list, so order here is the single source of truth.
title: ⚙️ emojig settings
help_fallback:
Settings

↑↓ select  ←→ change
? help   Esc back

options.label: shell integration
options.help:
Shell integration

Adds an `emojig` shell
function. Enable, then
`source` your shell rc.

options.label: shell key binding
options.help:
Shell key binding

Choose a keybinding.
Override by selecting 5
or edit shell_key_binding
in ~/.config/emojig/config

options.label: show all categories
options.help:
Show all categories

on/off — list every
category filter, or only
matching/used ones.

options.label: ambiguous chars
options.help:
Ambiguous chars

wide | narrow

options.label: theme
options.help:
Theme

dark | light | system

options.label: scrollbar
options.help:
